Username: Your API account username provided by Cyberlogic.
Password: Your API account password provided by Cyberlogic.
DateFrom: Start date of the stay or service period (YYYY-MM-DD).
DateTo: End date of the stay or service period (YYYY-MM-DD).
BookDate: Date the booking is made. Used to apply early-booking discounts or advance-purchase rates (YYYY-MM-DD).
Rooms: Room configuration block. Add one Room element per room required (max 4). Each Room specifies Adults, Children, and ChildrenAges attributes.
Adults: Number of adult guests (aged 12+) occupying the room.
Children: Number of child guests. Provide each child's age in ChildrenAges.
ChildrenAges: Comma-separated ages of the children in years (e.g. "5,8"). Must match the Children count exactly.
Infants: Number of infants (typically under 2 years). Infants generally travel free and do not occupy a seat.
HotelID: Numeric identifier of a specific hotel. Omit to search across all available properties.
HotelName: Partial hotel name filter. Returns properties whose name contains this string (case-insensitive).
RoomName: Partial room name filter. Restricts results to rooms matching this string.
Hoteltype: Property category: H = Hotel, A = Apartment, V = Villa, U = Unknown.
Location: Location category identifier. Retrieve valid IDs from the LocationCategories service.
Rating: Star-rating filter (1-5). Only hotels with this exact rating are returned.
Country: Country code filter (e.g. GR = Greece, CY = Cyprus, ES = Spain).
Province: Province / state identifier. Retrieve valid IDs from the Places service.
Prefecture: Prefecture identifier. Retrieve valid IDs from the Places service.
City: City identifier. Retrieve valid IDs from the Places service.
Board: Meal-plan filter - RR: Room Rate, BB: Bed & Breakfast, HB: Half Board, FB: Full Board, AI: All Inclusive, UI: Ultra Inclusive.
Language: BCP-47 language code for response content (en, de, fr, el, ru, it, es, nl). Defaults to en.
Residency: 2-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the traveller's country of residence (e.g. GB, DE, GR). Applies residency-specific rates where available.
OnRequest: Include on-request (not instantly confirmable) hotels in results. Default false.
ShowVarious: Include miscellaneous / various accommodation types in results.
ShowCancellationFees: Include cancellation-fee schedule detail in the response.
NoCache: Bypass the availability cache and fetch live data directly from suppliers. Slower but always current.
Extranet: Apply extranet (B2B) pricing rules. For authorised partner accounts only.
IgnoreTariff: Ignore tariff-based pricing restrictions and return all available rates.
GroupRoomBoards: Group pricing results by room and board type in the response structure.
UseTariff: Apply tariff-based pricing to the search results.
IsOptimized: When true, returns a faster, less detailed response optimised for search listings. Set false for full room details.
ShowFeatured: Return only featured or promoted items.
ReturnPickupDate: Return transfer pickup date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when RoundTrip is true.
RoundTrip: Set to true to include a return transfer leg in the same request.
StationID: Station / operating-branch identifier for the service provider.
RoutePointFrom: Departure route point ID. Retrieve valid IDs from the Transfer Route Points service.
RoutePointTo: Arrival route point ID. Retrieve valid IDs from the Transfer Route Points service.
FlightArrival: Arrival flight number (e.g. A3 123). Used for transfer timing coordination.
FlightDeparture: Departure flight number (e.g. FR 456). Used for transfer timing coordination.
VehicleID: Specific vehicle type identifier. Omit to return all available vehicle options.
PickupDropOffPoint: Specific pickup or drop-off location name or identifier.
GroupID: Vehicle group / category identifier (e.g. economy, compact, SUV).
AccommodationID: Accommodation identifier used as delivery or collection location.
Delivery: Delivery location (address or station) for the vehicle.
Collection: Collection / return location for the vehicle.
ExcursionID: Unique identifier of the excursion. Obtain from the Excursion List service.
PriceZoneID: Pricing zone identifier. Different zones may carry different rates for the same excursion.
NoHTML: Set to true to strip HTML markup from description fields in the response.
ScheduleLanguageID: Schedule language identifier for multilingual excursion descriptions.
BoardID: Board / meal-plan identifier for package pricing.
Quantity: Number of units (rooms, seats, vehicles) to request.
ReservationID: Unique identifier of an existing reservation. Required for confirmation, cancellation, and list queries.
DetailID: Identifier of a specific service line within a reservation.
BookingType: Category of the booking (e.g. hotel, transfer, excursion, package).
BookingStatus: Current status of the reservation (e.g. confirmed, on-request, cancelled).
UseHotelTariff: Apply hotel-contracted tariff rates to this reservation.
Reference: Your internal reference number for tracking this request or booking.
Remarks: Free-text special requests or notes to include with the booking.
ClientTransferArrivalType: Transfer type for client arrival (e.g. flight, own transport).
Title: Guest title (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, etc.).
Name: Guest first / given name.
Birthday: Guest date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for some services and destinations.
Passport: Guest passport number. Required for certain markets and booking types.
Email: Guest email address for booking confirmation and communications.
Telephone: Guest contact telephone number including country code.
Mobile: Guest mobile / cell phone number including country code.
CardType: Credit / debit card type (e.g. Visa, Mastercard, Amex).
CardHolder: Full name of the card holder exactly as printed on the card.
CardNumber: Card primary account number (PAN). Transmit only over secure (HTTPS) connections.
cvv2: Card security code - CVV2 (Visa), CVC2 (Mastercard), or CID (Amex). 3 or 4 digits.
ContractID: Contract identifier returned in search results. Pass this back unchanged when making a booking.
RoomQuantity: Number of rooms of this type to book.
HotelAddress: Physical address of the hotel (returned in responses).
PlaceType: Type of geographic entity to retrieve (City, Prefecture, Province, Country, Station).
ShowRates: Include detailed rate information in the offer list response.
OfferType: Category of the promotion (e.g. early-bird, last-minute, stay-pay).
EntryFromDate: Start of the travel-date window eligible for this offer (YYYY-MM-DD).
EntryToDate: End of the travel-date window eligible for this offer (YYYY-MM-DD).
RsvFromDate: Earliest booking date for this offer (YYYY-MM-DD).
RsvToDate: Latest booking date for this offer (YYYY-MM-DD).
ApplyToSupplements: Apply the offer discount to supplement charges as well as the base rate.
IsPercent: If true, the discount value is a percentage; otherwise it is an absolute amount.
StayPay: Stay-pay promotion definition (e.g. stay 7 nights, pay 5).
Response: Root element of the service response. Contains the result data or error list.
ErrorList: Container for any errors or warnings returned by the service.
Errors: List of error messages. A non-empty list means the request could not be fulfilled.
Warnings: List of warning messages. The response may still contain partial data.
Error: Individual error message describing what went wrong.
Warning: Individual warning message indicating a non-fatal issue.
ImageThumbURL: URL of the hotel thumbnail image.
Longitude: Geographic longitude of the property (WGS-84 decimal degrees).
Latitude: Geographic latitude of the property (WGS-84 decimal degrees).
TypeDescription: Human-readable property type name (e.g. Hotel, Apartment, Villa).
OfficialRating: Official star classification as assigned by the national tourism authority.
Description: Full descriptive text for the property or service.
LowRate: Lowest available rate across all room types for the search period.
LowestPrice: Lowest total price across all available options.
SpecialOffer: Indicates whether a promotional offer is available for this property.
Availability: Number of available units (rooms, vehicles, seats) matching the search criteria.
NonRefundable: Indicates this rate is non-refundable; cancellation will incur a full charge.
StopSales: Indicates this option is currently closed for new bookings.
MinLOSError: Indicates the selected stay is shorter than the minimum length-of-stay required for this room.
ReleaseError: Indicates the booking date is within the release/stop-sales period for this room.
RecordCount: Total number of records matching the search criteria.
Overnights: Number of nights calculated from DateFrom to DateTo.
NumberOfRooms: Total number of rooms requested across all room configurations.
CheckInTime: Standard check-in time for the property (HH:MM).
CheckOutTime: Standard check-out time for the property (HH:MM).
OpenAllYear: Indicates whether the property operates year-round.
HasIndoorPool: Property has an indoor swimming pool.
HasOutdoorPool: Property has an outdoor swimming pool.
HasSPAWellnessCentre: Property has a spa and wellness centre.
HasFitnessFacility: Property has a gym / fitness facility.
HasDataPorts: Property offers data ports / wired internet in rooms.
HasKitchen: Rooms include a kitchen or kitchenette.
HasFamilyRooms: Property has rooms suitable for families.
HasGolfCourse: Property has or is adjacent to a golf course.
HasHandicapAccessible: Property has facilities for guests with disabilities.
RR: Room Rate - room only, no meals included.
BB: Bed & Breakfast - overnight stay with breakfast.
HB: Half Board - breakfast and dinner included.
FB: Full Board - breakfast, lunch, and dinner included.
AI: All Inclusive - all meals, snacks, and selected beverages included.
UI: Ultra Inclusive - all inclusive plus premium beverages and additional services.
Discount: Discount amount applied to this rate (absolute or percentage depending on context).
Code: Occupancy configuration code: R1 = single, R2 = double/twin, R3 = triple, R4 = quadruple.
RatesFilter: Identifier of the rates filter applied to this result set.
StopWatch: Internal performance timing data for the service call.
Split: Individual timing segment label from the stop-watch performance trace.
StateProvinceName: Name of the state or province where the property is located.
OfficialRating_ID: Numeric identifier of the hotel's official star-rating classification.
Property_Class_ID: Numeric identifier of the property class or accommodation type.
SalesID: Sales contract identifier associated with this occupancy rate.
IsOpaque: When true, the hotel identity is hidden until after the booking is confirmed (opaque rate).
SelfCatering: When true, this unit is a self-catering property (kitchen facilities provided).
giata_id: GIATA (Global Accommodation Information and Technology Association) unique property identifier.
Records: Total number of hotel records returned in this response.
Nationality: 2-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 nationality code of the traveller (e.g. GB, DE, GR). Used for nationality-specific pricing rules.
Currency: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for returned prices (e.g. EUR, GBP, USD). Defaults to the account's base currency.
HotelIDs: Comma-separated list of hotel IDs to search (e.g. 101,202,303). Use instead of HotelID to search multiple specific hotels.
